newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights drop on excess liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights drop on excess liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates dropped on Friday amid high liquidity and dealers said they would remain low on Saturday because of inflowing funds.

"Bids and offers were quoted at five and 10 percent at the open, but deals were struck at around six percent," one dealer said. "Later rates bounced back a little and deals were even struck at 11 percent."
Dealers said rates would stay in single digits on Saturday because of an inflow of about 1.5 billion rupees from an open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan.
